title: WorkspaceList
description: Output of `dmtool workspace list <dir>` — a kernel-free per-model index of a directory of document models. Each model carries its identity, the super/subtype convention (the `abstract`/`superTypes`/`subTypes` header annotations), and every model reference (an `include` or a type-def import) cross-resolved to its file WITHIN the scan: `resolvedPath` is the referenced model's relative path, or null when no scanned model has that id (dangling, or out of the scan's scope — widen with --recursive). Under --validate each model additionally reports whether it reached the consistency gate: `checked:true` carries `valid` plus the `verification` mode that arbitrated it, `checked:false` carries `problem` instead — an unreadable or unresolvable model is NOT reported as `valid:false`, because no verdict was reached.

models.description: the indexed models, ordered by relative path

path.description: the model file's path relative to the scanned root ('/'-normalized)

label.description: the model's display label (first declared locale); absent if none

abstract.description: the `abstract` header-annotation convention — a base type, not instantiated directly

superTypes.description: model ids this one declares as supertypes (`superTypes` annotation, comma-split)

subTypes.description: model ids this one declares as subtypes (`subTypes` annotation, comma-split)

typedefImports.description: type-def imports (merged by id, not mounted), cross-resolved

providesTypedefs.description: the reusable type-def ids this model declares (what an importer can reference)

groups.description: number of groups in the model's own structure

fields.description: number of fields in the model's own structure

checked.description: did this model reach the consistency gate? present only under --validate. false means no verdict was produced — see `problem`

valid.description: kernel-valid? present only under --validate, and only when `checked` is true

verification.description: which gate arbitrated this model's verdict; present exactly when `valid` is

problem.description: why the model never reached the gate (unreadable, unparseable, an unresolvable reference); present exactly when `checked` is false — never a substitute for `valid:false`, which is a verdict

ref.description: the included model's id, which every mount of it names in `includeConfig.reference` — the include's only identity (DM 29.4)

resolvedPath.description: the referenced model's relative path within the scan, or null if unresolved

ref.description: the imported type-def provider model id

resolvedPath.description: the provider model's relative path within the scan, or null if unresolved
